note: [LLM critic, medium conf] Beta travels 25.9 in, a 3-turn trip, to the empty obj_nml_1. Other Custodian units are much closer to it and can take it. The score also lets a large contest_race penalty be outweighed by a huge objective_priority. Fix: Cap objective_priority by travel time and discount it to near zero when arrival is 3 or more turns away. Do not send a unit to an objective if a friendly unit is already closer or already assigned. Penalise a lone unit sent more than 20 in away when the contest_race estimate says it will lose. Prefer a nearer objective or a hold for a back-line unit.
